title: 붙여넣기 주문 영업방 원문의 현장 추가취소방 전달 근거

criteria.request: Authenticated POST with selected year and full year-week-subweek, at most 200 raw sources, at most 20000 characters per source and 200000 total characters. accountActive=false is forbidden. No sending or ERP write.
criteria.source: Only canonical nenovakakao|chat_id|external_message_id identities from 영업방 with exact original raw text and valid nonapproximate timezone-bearing timestamp in selected KST year can match. Uploaded rows remain UNCONFIRMED.
criteria.target: Fixed authenticated nenova-delivery-feed endpoint only, room exactly 현장 추가취소방, source nenovakakao, distinct valid identity, target timestamp not before source and in selected KST year. No legacy fallback.
criteria.match: Complete text equality after NFC and whitespace normalization only. Duplicate source texts/identities, client duplicateOriginal=true across request batches, or multiple qualifying targets are AMBIGUOUS for new matches. Existing durable verified evidence remains DELIVERED. Partial, truncated, approximate, cross-year and earlier targets cannot produce DELIVERED.
criteria.capacity: KST current inclusive recent three calendar days, <=200 target rows per page and <=20 pages; incomplete or invalid feed fails closed for new matches. Whole upstream scan has a 15 second deadline. Successful fixed-period feed cached for 30 seconds; failures never cached.
criteria.response: Returns source identity/status and matched deliveryIdentity/deliveredAt with persisted=true and verifiedAt when stored. A partial upstream failure returns saved DELIVERED plus unknown UNCONFIRMED and warning; without any saved evidence upstream failure is 502. No unrelated target raw messages, token, sending capability or ERP application claim. DELIVERED means exact forwarding evidence only.
criteria.persistence: Only server-verified exact forwarding evidence is stored atomically under data/runtime/distribution-delivery-evidence. Immutable records keyed by selected year plus exact original identity, raw text, timestamp and validity flags are shared across accounts and full-week changes. No expiry or overwrite by unmatched/ambiguous/read failure; response warning distinguishes failed refresh from saved DELIVERED evidence. No ERP tables change.
criteria.metadataRefresh: For identical raw text and canonical identity only, refresh source metadata. Upgrade approximate timestamp only from explicitly nonapproximate valid fresh timestamp. Preserve UI/analysis fields and truncated/is_truncated flags.
criteria.diagnostics: Keep reason codes and safe aggregate targetCount/qualifiedSourceCount when live scan succeeds. Stored-only lookup does not claim a fresh target scan.
criteria.loading: Initial/scope-change rows show checking before lookup. Exact verified facts survive appended rows, week changes and refresh failures; changed source/year cannot inherit. Unknown rows show lookup failure separately.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025 source and 2027 target cannot confirm selected 2026 year; selected full week must share year.

dnspyEvidence.note: Web-only Kakao read; native evidence documents the preserved ERP boundary. No native SQL or save behavior is invoked or modified.
